data.summary: auto_approve_after_retries requires N unanswered refusals of the same verb+item before auto-approving, but the dedup/possible-duplicate refusal prevents filing a second identical claim.force while one is outstanding, so the refusal count never reaches the threshold and auto-approve never fires. The retry rule should count refusals across lapsed/answered filings, not require N distinct outstanding ones. This is why the operator is still asked repeatedly despite the knob.
data.title: auto_approve_after_retries never accumulates: dedup blocks the second refusal

data.body:
Fixes bug Bf7c4b174ae: auto_approve_after_retries requires N unanswered refusals of the same verb+item before auto-approving, but the dedup/possible-duplicate refusal prevents filing a second identical claim.force while one is outstanding, so the refusal count never reaches the threshold and auto-approve never fires. The retry rule should count refusals across lapsed/answered filings, not require N distinct outstanding ones. This is why the operator is still asked repeatedly despite the knob.

data.title: Fix bug Bf7c4b174ae: auto_approve_after_retries never accumulates: dedup blocks the second refusal

Record the cross-family reviewer as the identifying reviewer (or accept a 0-finding cross-family review as satisfying independence) so a clean cross-family round is not discarded.

data.summary: A claim.force/complete.force approval may only be spent by its requesting agent, and an unspent approval expires after use_ttl_s=3600. When a lane files, auto-approves, then dies without spending, no successor lane can spend it and it expires, so the item is stranded at approved-0/1-used then dead. Approvals should be spendable by any successor lane of the same wave/coordinator, and/or a longer unspent TTL, so a dead agent does not orphan a granted approval.
data.title: unspent approvals are owner-gated and expire in 3600s, stranding re-claims

data.body:
Fixes bug B86be969daf: A claim.force/complete.force approval may only be spent by its requesting agent, and an unspent approval expires after use_ttl_s=3600. When a lane files, auto-approves, then dies without spending, no successor lane can spend it and it expires, so the item is stranded at approved-0/1-used then dead. Approvals should be spendable by any successor lane of the same wave/coordinator, and/or a longer unspent TTL, so a dead agent does not orphan a granted approval.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B86be969daf --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B86be969daf --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B86be969daf: unspent approvals are owner-gated and expire in 3600s, stranding re-claims
